description: This file contains a list of Python standard library modules and a function to check if a given module is part of the standard library based on a canonical list derived from external sources.

methods.name: bool is_stdlib_module(module: str)
methods.description: Checks whether a given module name is part of the Python standard library, based on the list obtained from sys.stdlib_module_names.

methods.name: _get_stdlib_modules()
methods.description: Returns the set of standard library module names obtained from sys.stdlib_module_names.
